- North: 53 units

Total = 202 units.

Caveats: Other columns have minor issues not affecting this question (Category has 3 whitespace variants, Price has 2 values written as "$300.00" text) – left alone as they do not impact Region/Quantity aggregation. No missing Region or Quantity values.
